versions.changelog:
Initial release of agent-transcript, a skill for redacting and safely inserting GitHub agent session transcripts.

- Provides local-only tools to find, sanitize, preview, and insert agent session transcripts into PR/issue bodies.
- Enforces strict redaction: removes secrets, private data, unrelated session turns, and raw logs.
- Never uploads raw logs or uses network; operates entirely on local data.
- Always asks the user before insertion and offers local HTML preview.
- Automates transcript section trimming to ensure only relevant context is included.
- Integrates cleanly into GitHub PR and issue workflows without requiring transcript if none is suitable.
